# Behance

> > Behance is Adobe's premier platform connecting creative professionals worldwide through portfolio showcases, freelance opportunities, and collaborative projects.

Behance serves as the leading creative network where designers, artists, photographers, and other creatives share their work, discover talent, and connect with clients. The platform offers both free and Pro membership tiers, integrating with Adobe Portfolio and providing tools for creative discovery and professional growth.
